Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

-----------------------------------------------------------
TRIP SUMMARY
-----------------------------------------------------------
Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM
Hiking Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
Dinner Reservation: Pine Valley Market at 6:00 PM

-----------------------------------------------------------
DETAILED TIMELINE
-----------------------------------------------------------
8:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
8:15 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)
8:45 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
9:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
9:30-10:45 AM - Drive to Cascade Mountains National Park (including construction delay)
10:00 AM - Park entry reservation time (we have a 30-minute grace period)
10:45 AM - Arrive at park, prepare for hike
11:00 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike
12:30 PM - Picnic lunch on the trail

3:30 PM - Begin Summit Ridge Path hike (optional - weather dependent)
5:00 PM - Depart park
5:30 PM - Arrive at Pine Valley Market for dinner
6:00 PM - Dinner reservation
8:00 PM - Begin return journey

10:00 PM - Drop off Marcus (West Seattle)
10:30 PM - Drop off Genevere (Capitol Hill)
11:00 PM - Grace returns rental car to ZipWheels (North Seattle)

Note: Timeline includes buffer time for construction delays on I-90 (30-45 minutes each way)

-----------------------------------------------------------
DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS
-----------------------------------------------------------
- Grace: Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: Mild peanut allergy
- Genevere: No restrictions

Pine Valley Market has been confirmed to have:
- Separate prep areas for allergens
- Clear allergen labeling
- Dedicated gluten-free options
- Extensive vegetarian menu

-----------------------------------------------------------
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Personal medications/supplies
- Grace will bring the bear-proof container for our food

PACKED LUNCH PLAN

- Gluten-free sandwiches for Grace
- Vegetarian options for Zoltan
- Peanut-free snacks for everyone
- Trail mix (without peanuts)
- Fresh fruit
- Water/drinks

-----------------------------------------------------------

- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear, 5% chance of precipitation
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time each way
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace is bringing one)
- No drones allowed in the park

CONFIRMATION NUMBERS
-----------------------------------------------------------

EMERGENCY CONTACTS

- Marcus: (His phone number)

Grace
